strings.donate_completion_body_family: App eni utiye tic pa ngati acel, man etiye i ot acel ku juru ot para. Ka ketho piny tin uketho piny doko yot, kawa ubedo yore maber mi konyo sawa man cwiny ma iye.
strings.donate_completion_body_kindness: Epe ku cul man piny moko epe ma jugwoko. Ka app ne ubedo ber tin, culu kawa i wange ubedo berocwiny ma nok ma weko ebedo agonya ni ngati mukende.
strings.donate_completion_body_momentum: Wageno kony ma nok pi culu wel piny mwa mi dwi ku dwi man bedo agonya. Kethu kawa acel kende kelo aloka loka madit i gwoko jam tic eni maber man maber.
strings.donate_completion_body_reciprocity: Updater CE utiye m'umbe cul, epe ku kwenda man epe ku lubo tok jeni, juculo ku kony ma nok pa dhanu calu in. Ka ketho eni ukonyo sawa peri nyo ekonyo jam tic peri tin, wilu iwa kawa miyo downloads man servers timo tic pi dhanu ceke.
strings.donate_completion_body_running_costs: Servers, storage man domains juculo pi dwi ku dwi, ​​kadi ngati moku uketho ceng eca nyo epe. Ka ketho piny tin ubedo maber, kawa konyo ni culu piny ma jutiyo kudu.
strings.donate_completion_body_small_hours: Pol pa tic eni timere i sawa manok ingey tic mi dieceng, man kawa ubedo yore maber mi wacu niya ubedu ber. Wafoyo pi bedo peri kany.
strings.donate_completion_body_transparency: 100% oyabere, maleng, man jumatiyo kudu — epe ku paywalls nyo piny ma jugwoko. Madhu chai pio pio iwi Ko-fi konyowa ni culu pi bandwidth man ka gwoko piny ma umiyu tego pa install peri tin.

strings.donate_intro_general: Nenedi! An a Ryan, jayub pa Jami manyen, Community Firmware Archive, man Themes Gallery. Aculu pi gwoko server, gwoko firmware, man dwoko domain manyen kud i cinga gira kara piny ceke ubed m'umbe cul. strings.support_methods_subtitle: Yer yore peri mi miyu kony ma ibemito. Mic moko ci konyowa ni kwanyo, gwoko, man temo jam tic.
strings.support_story_1_body: Innioasis kare ku kare wodhu firmwares manyen pi jurutugo calu Y1 (ma uketho i iye aloka loka mi board ma ungwe calu 6.0, 7.0, man 8.0) ma turo jam tic macon. Marac muloyo, kabedu migi mi intanet epe ku poyo wic man epe ku twero mi tiyo ku firmwares macon ni dwoko piny ma rac. Jami manyen man Community Firmware project tingo piny: wa gwoko ROM moko ci macon, wa ketho hardware peri manyen, man wa ketho player peri timo tic maber.
strings.support_story_1_headline: Ka ju ma yiku piny gimediri anyim, dhanu mi kabedo ne gi medere anyim.
strings.support_story_1_item_1: Laru jurutugo ma tur: Safety checks neno ni updates manyen kud utur hardware macon.
strings.support_story_1_item_2: Archived Stock ROMs: Dul pa firmwares macon pa factory Innioasis ujuko.
strings.support_story_1_item_3: Native Cross-Platform: Jam tic ma tiyo ku macOS, Linux, man Windows marom.
strings.support_story_1_item_4: Ngec pa jam tic: Nwangu board kende kende kara ibed ku jam tic maber.
strings.support_story_1_lead: Gwoko jam tic peri kud i cing jam tic ma ling man aloka loka ma rac.
strings.support_story_2_body: Lubu tok Innioasis software pol kare nyutho ni sayu forums pi Google Drive ma ukadhu kare migi, Baidu cloud shares ma tho, man zip files ma dhanu ungeye ngo ma tiye ku jam tic ma nyai. Wa gieru yore maber, ma tiye ku twero mi goyo piny ku SHA-256, lwongo mi dwoko piny manyen, man ketho lembe manyen. Mic peri gwoko piny ma juwodho man gwoko piny ma weko timo eni bedo tiye pi sawa 24 kubang ceng, ceng 365 kubang oro.
strings.support_story_2_headline: Google Drives ma tur epe. Tic mi paru epe. Firmware ma tiyo kende.
strings.support_story_2_item_1: Direct High-Speed ​​CDN: Golo piny pio pio man ma rwom pare lapiny manangu epe ku rwom mi golo piny nyo dead links.
strings.support_story_2_item_2: Lembe manyen: Nwang ngec ikare ma dul manyen wok nyoke timo moko wok.
strings.support_story_2_item_3: Guided Step-by-Step Installs: Clear visual prompts bikonyi ikare ma i diyo button moko ci.
strings.support_story_2_item_4: Kabedo ma dhanu weco i iye dhok mapol: Juweco i dhok mi Ingresa, China, German, Spanish, French & Japanese.
strings.support_story_2_lead: Piny ma tiyo pio pio, ma jumoko ungiyo ma icopo geno.
strings.support_story_3_body: Software mi factory kende kende nyayu piny ma Y1 nyo Y2 hardware peri copo timo. Kabedo mwa ukelo Rockbox, jam tic ma yot, wer pa codec, man lembe ma juyubu pi kwo. Wawilo jam tic matung tung kud i cingwa pi temo, dwoko piny, man ketho lembe moko ci. Cwaku Jami manyen konyowa ni culo pi test units eni man konyowa ni yubu firmware.
strings.support_story_3_headline: Yabu kero pa jatug peri mi Innioasis.
strings.support_story_3_item_1: One-Click Rockbox: Audiophile playback man custom themes ma juketho i sekond manok.
strings.support_story_3_item_2: Firmware mi kanisa: Medu pa battery, UI maleng, man kony pa audio codec manyen.
strings.support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Watemo iwi jam tic ma nen mandha mapodi wawodho ngo piny moku ci.
strings.support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% m'umbe cul, jam tic ma gwoko bedo peri giri ma epe ku kwenda nyo lubo tok jeni.
strings.support_story_3_lead: Kelo Rockbox, jam tic ma yot, man bedo agonya pa ju ma maru wer.
strings.support_story_4_body: Ka kampuni moko mi hardware umedire ku jam tic migi manyen, juweko jam tic macon. Innioasis epe ku kony pa Linux, epe ku changelogs ma nen kamaleng, man epe ku yore mayot mi dwoko piny ka install moko uthum. Jami manyen utiye pilembe jutic ma gimaru tiyu kudu ucikere ngo ni weko jam wer maber. 100% pa kony pa dhanu cidho direct i gwoko jam tic eni oyabere ni dhanu zo.
strings.support_story_4_headline: Konywa ni timo gin ma Innioasis timo ngo.
strings.support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: Proven recovery flows flows kadi bed ni jam tic okwero caku tic.
strings.support_story_4_item_2: Linux First-Class Support: MediaTek ma tiyo maber iwi Linux distros.
strings.support_story_4_item_3: Transparent Changelogs: Lembe ma jukoro ikum lembe ma juwodho kara ingei ikum aloka loka ango.
strings.support_story_4_item_4: 100% Community Funded: Kawa moko ci gwoko kagwoko piny ma jugwoku man ma dhanu ceke ung'eyo ngo.
strings.support_story_4_lead: Gwoko firmware ma dhanu timo ku tego pa dhanu ma gwoko jam tic peri kud i landfills.
